mapper.select: select distinct CUST_O_CODE, CUST_O_NAME from (select T2.* from DW_CUST_FINANCIER_MP T1 INNER JOIN DW_CUST_FINANCIER T2 ON T1.RELATE_CODE = T2.CUST_O_CODE WHERE T1.CUST_O_CODE = #{custOCode} union all select T2.* from DW_CUST_FINANCIER T2 WHERE T2.CUST_O_CODE = #{custOCode})
select T1.*,T2.CUST_O_NAME as RELATE_NAME from DW_CUST_FINANCIER_MP T1 INNER JOIN DW_CUST_FINANCIER T2 ON T1.RELATE_CODE = T2.CUST_O_CODE WHERE T1.CUST_O_CODE = #{custOCode}
